text:
Aisha (PM): quick sync — Acme wants launch in their us-east window w/ 99.9% read SLA. we need to confirm capacity + security review by EOD Thurs.
Marco (Eng): noted. do we have expected qps for their traffic pattern?
Tom (Customer Success): they gave rough numbers: 120 rps peak, lots of short chats, ~token length typical. they also want canary traffic split 5%->25%.
Jenna (Runtime): 120 rps at short sequences should be fine if batching=auto and prefix cache enabled, but latency SLO for 99.9% might need dedicated slots during peak.
Sam (Infra): dedicated slot ask is fine, we need a commit for reserved instances. how long of a window?
Aisha (PM): two weeks of reserved peak capacity around launch, then evaluation. budget ok per Tom.
Li (Security): we need the on-prem dataflow diagrams and KMS key policy by Tue to pass the compliance checklist. also confirm no customer PII stored in logs.
Tom (Customer Success): I’ll get diagrams from Acme and confirm logging settings today.
Marco (Eng): who will own the rollout policy + fallback? if private deploy flaps we need automatic fallback to hosted variant.
Jenna (Runtime): I can own the model-routing policy. propose: canary 5% (48h) -> 25% (24h) -> full. fallback target: rtx-quantized-v2-hosted.
Marco (Eng): sounds good. we'll need a config patch. putting draft here:
```yaml
rollout:
  - stage: canary
    pct: 5
    duration: 48h
  - stage: ramp
    pct: 25
    duration: 24h
fallback:
  target: rtx-quantized-v2-hosted
```
Sam (Infra): infra check: need IP allowlist from Acme + NAT routing for VPC peering. can we get the network CIDRs?
Tom (Customer Success): sending CIDRs now in DM.
Li (Security): also require HSM/KMS audit plan for key rotation. our standard template, Tom — can you confirm customer accepts rotation schedule?
Aisha (PM): action items: Tom - collect diagrams + CIDRs + rotation approval (today). Li - confirm checklist by Tue. Jenna - prepare routing/fallback config + latency sim (Mon). Marco - prep canary infra + run perf tests (Mon-Tue). Sam - reserve capacity & confirm billing flow (Wed).
Marco (Eng): perf test note — include cold-start + kv-cache-warm scenarios. run both with and without quantized kernels.
Jenna (Runtime): will do. quick question — do we want strict SLA enforcement via token throttling or adaptive degrade?
Aisha (PM): prefer graceful degrade: maintain availability, degrade max tokens for non-critical paths. add to rollout plan.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary window tentative 2026-05-04T01:00Z -> 2026-05-06T01:00Z, awaiting approvals.
Tom (Customer Success): Acme confirmed log redaction and key rotation schedule. sending signed agreement.
Li (Security): got it, starting checklist review. priority items: KMS policy, pen-test exception timeline.
Sam (Infra): reserved capacity booked for 14 days starting 2026-05-03. billing owner: Marco.
Marco (Eng): perf tests done (summary): p95 latency 130ms with cache warm, cold p95 420ms. with reserved slots p95 drops to 95ms. attaching truncated logs in thread.
Aisha (PM): excellent. next sync Wed 10am PT to confirm green to proceed. if any blocker before then, ping #product on the thread. :thumbsup:
Jenna (Runtime): noted, will push routing config PR and include fallback tests.
Tom (Customer Success): I'll confirm canary cutoff criteria with Acme (error budget, latency thresholds).
Aisha (PM): thanks everyone — moving action items to the launch checklist.
